note: Control IDs and short titles follow the named framework. The summaries and evidence hints are the project author's own paraphrases for retrieval and assessment, not the text of the framework. Consult the official publication for authoritative wording. The 'impact' weight (1-5) is a generic default for the risk scorer; tune it for your organisation. This library assesses at category level (22 categories), not the individual subcategories.

controls.title: Organizational context
controls.summary: The mission, stakeholder expectations, dependencies and legal and regulatory requirements that shape cybersecurity risk are understood.
controls.evidence_hint: Mission statements, dependency maps, legal and regulatory register

controls.title: Risk management strategy
controls.summary: Risk priorities, constraints, tolerance and appetite are set and used to support risk decisions.
controls.evidence_hint: Risk strategy, risk appetite statement

controls.title: Roles, responsibilities and authorities
controls.summary: Cybersecurity roles, responsibilities and authorities are established, communicated and enforced.
controls.evidence_hint: Role definitions, RACI matrix, board reporting

controls.title: Policy
controls.summary: Cybersecurity policy is established, communicated and enforced.
controls.evidence_hint: Approved policy set, communication and review records

controls.title: Oversight
controls.summary: Results of risk management activities are used to inform, improve and adjust the strategy.
controls.evidence_hint: Management reviews, security metrics, board reports

controls.title: Supply chain risk management
controls.summary: Supply chain risk processes are identified, established, managed and agreed with stakeholders.
controls.evidence_hint: Supplier requirements, due diligence records, contract clauses

controls.title: Asset management
controls.summary: Data, hardware, software, systems, facilities, services and people are identified and managed by their importance to objectives.
controls.evidence_hint: Asset inventory, data flow maps, owner assignments

controls.title: Risk assessment
controls.summary: Cybersecurity risk to the organization, its assets and individuals is understood.
controls.evidence_hint: Risk assessments, vulnerability and threat intelligence records

controls.title: Improvement
controls.summary: Improvements to risk management processes and activities are identified from all functions.
controls.evidence_hint: Lessons learned, audit findings, improvement plans

controls.title: Identity management, authentication and access control
controls.summary: Access to physical and logical assets is limited to authorized users, services and hardware and managed in line with assessed risk.
controls.evidence_hint: Identity and access policy, MFA configuration, access reviews

controls.title: Awareness and training
controls.summary: Personnel receive cybersecurity awareness and training so they can do their tasks.
controls.evidence_hint: Training programme and completion records

controls.title: Data security
controls.summary: Data is managed in line with risk strategy to protect confidentiality, integrity and availability.
controls.evidence_hint: Encryption standards, backup records, data loss prevention

controls.title: Platform security
controls.summary: Hardware, software and services of physical and virtual platforms are managed in line with risk strategy.
controls.evidence_hint: Configuration baselines, patch management, logging standard

controls.title: Technology infrastructure resilience
controls.summary: Security architecture is managed to protect confidentiality, integrity, availability and resilience of assets.
controls.evidence_hint: Network segmentation design, redundancy and capacity records

controls.title: Continuous monitoring
controls.summary: Assets are monitored to find anomalies, indicators of compromise and other potentially adverse events.
controls.evidence_hint: Monitoring tools, alert rules, monitoring reports

controls.title: Adverse event analysis
controls.summary: Anomalies and indicators of compromise are analysed to characterize events and detect incidents.
controls.evidence_hint: Triage procedure, event correlation, severity criteria

controls.title: Incident management
controls.summary: Responses to detected cybersecurity incidents are managed.
controls.evidence_hint: Incident response plan, incident tickets, roles

controls.title: Incident analysis
controls.summary: Investigations are conducted to ensure effective response and to support forensics and recovery.
controls.evidence_hint: Forensic procedure, root cause analysis records

controls.title: Incident response reporting and communication
controls.summary: Response activities are coordinated with internal and external stakeholders.
controls.evidence_hint: Communication plan, regulator and customer notification procedure

controls.title: Incident mitigation
controls.summary: Activities prevent an event from spreading and reduce its effects.
controls.evidence_hint: Containment playbooks, isolation procedures

controls.title: Incident recovery plan execution
controls.summary: Restoration activities are carried out to bring affected systems and services back into operation.
controls.evidence_hint: Recovery plan, restore test results, recovery time records

controls.title: Incident recovery communication
controls.summary: Restoration activities are coordinated with internal and external parties.
controls.evidence_hint: Recovery communication plan, stakeholder update records
